concept_uz: Qirol Noʻl qaror qiladi: ratsional ham, irratsional ham — haqiqiy sonlar. Ikki xalq birlashib, Haqiqiy sonlar imperiyasiga asos soladi; oʻqda birorta teshik qolmaydi. Katta toʻy: Uch kuylaydi, egizaklar yana gʻoyib boʻladi. Yarim tunda oʻqning ustidan ovoz keladi: «Men √(−1)man…»
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden light, soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round golden ring-shaped king: a smooth, thick, upright gold ring like a donut standing on its edge, with big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast empty golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on a vast golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty golden plain under a huge sky, a warm sun low on the right horizon and a pale smiling moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left side of the sky, soft morning light, a faint straight line on the ground running from left to right through the centre. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The king's long wooden staff lying flat on the golden plain from left to right, with evenly spaced carved notches along it, the middle notch glowing gold. Low camera angle along the staff, morning light, no characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A chubby, energetic purple character shaped like a curvy rounded number-three shape with two bulges, big excited eyes, open mouth mid-speech, wearing a shiny wedding-host jacket and holding a golden microphone. Golden plain with festive lanterns, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the golden plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. An elderly scholar character with a round kind face, small spectacles and a long white beard, wearing a deep-blue chapan robe covered in a pattern of circles, holding a coil of measuring rope. He stands beside a wooden cart wheel on the golden plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A lively bazaar merchant character with a curled moustache and a bright embroidered doppi cap, grinning, holding a leather coin purse that is visibly swelling and bulging with gold coins. A colourful market stall on the golden plain behind him, front view, centred.

A grand evening feast along the glowing notched staff on the golden plain: long tables, huge pots of plov, lanterns, and many number-characters celebrating together, the purple microphone character and the merchant among them. Keep their designs exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: On the palace square the ring-king faces two crowds — the bright fraction folk on one side and the caged characters with the scholar on the other — and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Siz ikkalangiz ham haqiqiysiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Both crowds erupt in cheers; the caged teal character proudly lifts its cage high for the first time. The scholar begins, says in Uzbek with a slow, sleepy elderly professor's voice: "Rahmat… uch butun, bir, to'rt…" and everyone gently, laughingly, puts their hands over his mouth. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Along the whole staff every tiny dark gap fills with light, one after another, until the line glows without a single hole from horizon to horizon. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Haqiqiy sonlar imperiyasi tug'ildi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

At the feast the merchant leans over the plov pot with his purse and says in Uzbek with a quick, smooth bazaar-trader's voice: "Oshning narxi, foiz ustiga foiz…" Two guards politely lift him by the arms and carry him to the far end of the table. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The purple character grabs the microphone again — and this time the whole feast sings along, swaying with raised cups: everyone says in Uzbek with a crowd of cheerful mixed voices in unison: "Uch, uch, uch!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The gold and silver twins, overjoyed, hug each other — POP — they vanish. The whole table bursts out laughing and shouts, says in Uzbek with a crowd of cheerful mixed voices in unison: "Yana-ya?!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Midnight. The ring-king stands alone at the centre of the glowing line under a sky full of stars, smiling peacefully, and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Hammaga joy bor." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Above the line, high in the air where nothing should be, a tiny glowing violet figure floats down and says in Uzbek with a tiny, shy, echoing child's voice: "Kechirasiz… men ildiz ostida minus birman. Meni ham qabul qilasizlarmi?" The king jumps, his crown flying off, and stares up. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Birinchi mavsum tugadi. Davomi — powerty.uz da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Kechirasiz… men ildiz ostida minus birman. Meni ham qabul qilasizlarmi?
Birinchi mavsum tugadi. Davomi — powerty.uz da.
